_derivation.tabs: First child, explicit size [320,36] -> (20,20,320,36). Segment pitch: 4 segments, gap 8, content width 320 => segW = (320 - 8*3)/4 = 296/4 = 74. seg i x = 20 + i*(74+8): seg0=20, seg1=102, seg2=184, seg3=266.
_derivation.list: Second child, gap 16 below tabs: y = 20 + 36 + 16 = 72 -> (20,72,320,160). Column, gap 0, padding 0, so content box is the full rect.

Rows are laid out from y=72: row0 (20,72,320,40); sep:0 (20,112,320,1); row1 (20,113,320,40); sep:1 (20,153,320,1); row2 (20,154,320,40). Width 320 = stretched cross axis (align-items stretch) for the dividers; the rows pin width 320 explicitly.

points.tab_unselected: segment 0 fill is #E5E7EB. Sample 4px inside its top-left (20+4, 20+4) = (24,24): clear of the centred glyph and inside the radius-6 rounded corner (4^2+4^2=32 <= 6^2=36... actually (6-4)^2+(6-4)^2=8 <= 36).

points.list_row: row0 is transparent, so its area shows the list background #F9FAFB. Sample near the right edge (20+320-4, 72+4) = (336,76) to be clear of the 'Alpha' glyphs at the left.

points.root_bg: root background is #FFFFFF. Sample (4,4), outside the 20px padding.
